primary_goal.definition: Average daily visits to https://gnsresearchhub.vercel.app over a rolling 30-day period. Prefer unique visitors when provider data is available; otherwise use page sessions/visits consistently and label the limitation.

measurement_status.provider_checked: Live Vercel Web Analytics script + GA4 tag + direct Vercel API discovery from cron
measurement_status.raw_result: Live /_vercel/insights/script.js and GA4 tag are present. VERCEL_TOKEN exists, but direct Vercel analytics/web-insights endpoints tested in this cron run returned HTTP 404, and no GA4 Data API property/service-account credential is configured in env. Central 30d visits remain unavailable to the agent.
measurement_status.interpretation: Measurement blocker remains: provide GA4 Data API access (GA4_PROPERTY_ID plus GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS path or GA4_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON) or an approved Vercel Analytics export/API method so rolling 30-day visits can be reported numerically toward 500/day.

north_star: Help BSS retail owners find practical, evidence-backed product insights often enough that the hub becomes a repeat visit destination.
growth_channels: A/B testing of landing and CTA copy

needs_user_permission_or_credentials.why: The GA4 tag is live, but this cron run cannot read GA4 reporting data without a GA4 property ID plus a service-account JSON/key mounted in env or another approved server-side access method. Needed to report rolling 30-day visits centrally.
A memorable domain improves trust, repeat visits, and shareability versus a vercel.app URL.
Actual X/Twitter posting requires xurl CLI availability and OAuth credentials configured outside the agent session; never paste secrets into chat.
Paid tests require explicit budget, platform, and stop-loss rules before execution.

initial_experiments.success_metric: ranking CTA clicks and item card clicks per visit
initial_experiments.hypothesis: Retail-owner action language will produce more clicks than evidence-first language for busy BSS owners.

initial_experiments.success_metric: share intent clicks, copy-link events, and UTM-attributed return visits
initial_experiments.hypothesis: Owner-ready share links with item-specific display tips will increase repeat visits and make SNS/sales-rep distribution measurable once analytics is connected.

initial_experiments.success_metric: measured visits, ranking CTA clicks, item card clicks, and share/copy events by UTM channel
initial_experiments.hypothesis: Provider-backed measurement will distinguish real growth from routine refresh/deploy activity.

initial_experiments.success_metric: organic landing visits to ranking and item detail pages; indexed URL count; item-card clicks from organic sessions
initial_experiments.hypothesis: Canonical URLs, OG/Twitter images, schema.org ItemList/Product JSON-LD, robots.txt, and sitemap.xml make item-ranking pages easier to index and share, increasing repeatable organic visits toward 500/day.

initial_experiments.success_metric: item detail share/copy clicks and UTM-attributed return visits
initial_experiments.hypothesis: Specific item-detail pages with owner-ready display/risk copy create more repeat visits than timeframe-only sharing links.

reporting.daily_growth_director: Report current measured traffic if credentials exist; otherwise report tracking readiness, marketing actions, blockers, and next permission needed.
reporting.hourly_ai_operator: Keep improving product insight quality, SEO/shareability, tracking, experiments, and conversion paths while preserving source/evidence discipline.

vercel_web_analytics.measurement_note: Vercel dashboard measures visitors, page views, referrers, geography, devices, and custom events without cookies.

ga4.event_bridge: assets/growth.js sends growth_exposure, growth_click, and growth_share_copy_result through gtag when available.

internal_growth_events.purpose: A/B variant, UTM persistence, share/copy/click events, and provider fan-out to Vercel Analytics and GA4.

sns_strategy.role: Drive BSS-owner repeat visits with concise, evidence-backed weekly item insights and UTM-tagged links.
sns_strategy.posting_rule_summary: After xurl is installed/authenticated, auto-post only safe evidence-backed ranking links within limits; keep replies/DMs/paid ads approval-only.
